title: telemetry
description: Phase 4.6: optional telemetry events. The `telemetry.v1` agent today aggregates over every observed bus topic without publishing back, so this schema describes the *shape* a future producer MUST follow if it ever does emit on this topic. Operationally the topic is reserved for sparse, hand-emitted events (deploys, manual replays); the bus is not the bulk metrics path.

topic.description: Bus topic the event refers to, when relevant.
